role: I build reliable software and cloud-native delivery workflows with .NET and Azure, with a growing focus on developer experience and AI-assisted engineering.
introduction: Software Engineer with more than five years of experience building enterprise applications and cloud delivery systems across Belgian public-sector, banking, and energy projects. I bring C#/.NET development and software engineering practices to Azure, Terraform, and GitHub-based workflows.
description:
I'm a software engineer who enjoys the full development lifecycle, from understanding requirements and choosing an architecture to writing maintainable code, testing, deploying, and operating it.

Since 2020, I've worked across Belgian public-sector and enterprise teams: first on application development and modernization, then on Azure infrastructure and DevOps automation. My software engineering background shapes how I work with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and developer tooling. I care about clear design, code quality, and repeatable delivery.

I'm particularly interested in Developer Experience (DevEx) and how AI-assisted development can improve engineering workflows when it is evaluated for usefulness, security, and quality. I also enjoy mentoring developers and sharing what I learn through technical writing. Outside work, I like travelling and cooking.
